headline: A 2000 executive order directing federal agencies to improve how they manage their environmental impact.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to lead by example in managing its own effects on the environment. It appears aimed at how federal agencies run their operations. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, goals, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies appear to be directed to change how they manage the environmental effects of their operations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 21, 2000; specific deadlines are not given in the source material.
